cases.title: After CDEDIT the pipes you had selected are still selected
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with daily card D17 (DAILY_TOOLS_TEST_CASES_2026-10-23.md): one pipe selected stays selected after Edit Pipe Save; two pipes stay selected after the Edit 2 Pipes editor is closed. The second pipe is the first other pipe in the drawing, not a pipe named by the card.
cases.expected: Pick pipe P3 (10A98D) first, run CDEDIT, answer Y, press Save in Edit Pipe with nothing changed: the selection is still exactly 10A98D. Then pick P3 and the new pipe together, run CDEDIT, close the editor that opens by its Cancel: the selection is still exactly those two. No CE window is left open at the end.
cases.why_not_unit: Selection restore runs against AutoCAD's live implied selection after a real modal window.
not_automated: The batch editor for two pipes is titled "Edit 2 Pipes" on 3.0.72 (read on 24 Oct 2026). If no editor closes by Cancel the step is BLOCKED.
Whether the first Save changed the drawing is not checked (the drawing's change counter is not read).

cases.title: Erasing the pit P3 that has several pipes keeps every pipe, says how many pipe ends are now Not connected, and one U restores the pit
cases.plan_item: UX-EDIT-01 (daily case D14, pit P3 with several pipes); BUG family M2 (ERASE and OOPS)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Written from the review's own proposal (RUNNER_CASE_REVIEW_R11_R20_2026-10-24.md item 9, R19b) and daily card D14. The Pit Schedule half of D14 is not covered.
cases.expected: Select the pit P3 (109D56) and type ERASE: the command line says 'The pit was erased and the schedule is updated. N pipes now have ends that are Not connected yet. U restores everything.' (N two or more), the pipe 10A98D is still there, and one U (echo word ERASE) brings the pit back on the STORMWATER PIT layer.
cases.why_not_unit: The message comes from CE watching a real native ERASE and its links in the drawing.
not_automated: The Pit Schedule figures after the erase and after U (card D14) are not read: the driver cannot close the Pit Schedule on 3.0.72/3.0.73.
The links coming back after U (that each pipe end is joined to the pit again) are not read; only the pit's return is.
